text:
When me dices: Soy tuya,
your voice is miel and is aroma,
is igual that una paloma
torcaz that a his macho arrulla.


Over my hand dormida
of your nuca siento el peso,
mientras you sorbo in un beso
todo el fuego of la life.


When ciega and suspirante
your cuerpo recorre una
convulsión agonizante,


adquiere your faz inerte
under el blancor of la moon
la palidez of la Death.

translation.title: El poema of la carne
translation.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.
